result:
I ported `scripts/hero.gd` to Godot 4 (I couldn't run it here). `hero.tscn` already used Godot 4 node types, so I left it alone.

The script now uses `@tool`, `CharacterBody2D`, `@export_range(100, 600)`, `@onready`, `Engine.is_editor_hint()`, `move_and_slide()` on the `velocity` property, the `coins_changed.emit()` signal call, `await` for the 0.15 s flash and `Color.WHITE`.
